subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 22, 2026
body:
Subject: Bottom-bar icons are clickable again in both AcreetionOS editions

The fix everyone quietly wanted landed today: "fixed the icon's not clickable on bottom bar :)" is committed in both cobra3282000/acreetionos and cobra3282000/acreetionos-xlibre, so launcher clicks on the panel behave the same in the Cinnamon and XLibre builds.

Development

Darren also brought the welcome-screen repo back from the dead, committing "updating and fixing missing stuff so its back :)" — if your first boot greeting looked sparse lately, that's why. Over in the same tree, the Electron bump to 44 is described as fixing "a lot of problems," which is the kind of commit message that means someone lost an afternoon so you don't have to. The full sequence is on the changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.

Community

Natalie made the initial commit in natalie/acreetionos-wallpapers, which means the project finally has a home for shipped desktop art instead of scattering it across repos. Two upstream notes worth your attention: Vim Classic 8.3.1 is out at vim-classic.org, and Beyls is wrapping up LLVM's relicensing effort — both will trickle down to us through Arch. Say hi in Discord (https://acreetionos.org/) if you want to argue about wallpapers before they land.

Tip of the day

If you're running an older ISO and the panel fix hasn't reached you yet, a full system update gets you there faster than cherry-picking packages, and it avoids the classic Arch partial-upgrade headache. Run it, reboot, and if Cinnamon still acts stiff, restart the shell with cinnamon --replace before you file anything. More recovery tricks live in the wiki at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html.

Grab the current images at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html and let us know if the bar still swallows a click. Two developers, one OS, and today one fewer annoying bug.
